name: kadi-teri
description: Kadi Teri, a mobile-first hidden partnership card game.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
